verifications.note: RBN Energy project profile page titled 'Empire North Expansion', Operator: Empire Pipeline, states 'In Service Date: Q3/2020'.

EIA Today in Energy (Aug. 24, 2020): 'The 0.3 Bcf/d Empire North Expansion Project, which increases deliverability to western New York consumers on the Empire Pipeline, entered partial service in late June [2020].'

resolutions.researcher_notes: Sheet records StartYear1=2020 for the 'North Expansion' segment. RBN Energy's project profile for 'Empire North Expansion' (Operator: Empire Pipeline, Diameter 26in, Length 25mi, Capacity 300 MMcf/d, Origin Jackson PA -> Destination Chippawa ON) gives In Service Date Q3/2020. EIA's Today in Energy (Aug 2020) independently confirms the same named project entered (partial) service in late June 2020. Both agree on YEAR=2020 as recorded; the exact quarter/month differs slightly across sources (RBN: Q3; EIA: late June/Q2, consistent with a phased partial-then-full in-service). EIA's own pipeline-projects historical dataset (see Length/Diameter records below) separately lists an exact Completed Date of 2020-06-26 for 'Empire North Expansion Project', reconciling the two: partial service in late June, full/Q3 completion. No change to the recorded value; ref only.
